claims.explanation: Fludroxycortide is a glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) agonist, and its selective antiproliferative effect across cancer lines is most plausibly driven by NR3C1 expression: lines with high glucocorticoid receptor levels mount a stronger transcriptional response (TSC22D3/DDIT4 induction, MYC/NFKBIA modulation) and are growth-inhibited, while receptor-poor lines are protected. Because glucocorticoids also induce SERPINA6/CBG and depend on downstream cofactors, additional sensitivity may come from intact GR signaling and from lineage context (e.g., lymphoid/hematologic lines, where glucocorticoids classically induce apoptosis).
